items.title: Will a proposed surveillance-technology contract be rejected or rolled back by local oversight?
items.content_html: A speculative outcome bounty focused on public oversight of surveillance technology. If verified public records show the proposed contract is rejected or rolled back, funds support a designated local digital-rights or community accountability organization. No accusations are presumed; outcomes rely on verifiable public decisions.
